title: Reported split translation segments can misalign neighboring speech balloons
symptom: A user reported a translated line truncated mid-sentence, with subsequent translated texts shifted to adjacent balloon IDs.
user_impact: Translated dialogue can be assigned to the wrong speaker or lose meaning even though each individual segment parses cleanly.

steps: Issue author proposes source/translation length checks, punctuation checks, echoed source prefixes and targeted re-request of flagged segments.

remaining_question: Is the issue reproducible in current release, and can an integrity checker detect it before export?
verification_plan: Use a permitted synthetic 6-bubble page; inject a model response with one split/missing id; assert detection rather than silently assigning the next text.
